description:
Fair Deal Property, Your Trusted Experts For Residential Property Sales,

Are delighted to present Number 62 Woodfield to the market; an exceptional owner-occupied family residence situated in a quiet cul-de-sac within one of Tuam’s most accessible and convenient residential developments.

Beautifully maintained and extensively upgraded throughout, this cherished home reflects its owners’ painstaking attention to detail. With very little passing traffic, its peaceful cul-de-sac setting also provides an ideal environment for children to play.

The property is located less than a minute’s drive from the M17/M18 motorway network, providing superb connectivity to Galway City and beyond, while Tuam town centre remains within walking distance.

On arrival, you are greeted by a handsome brick façade incorporating a newly fitted, energy- efficient composite front door with glazed sidelights which fill the spacious entrance hallway with natural light, while fresh décor and contemporary flooring create an immediate sense of
quality and modernity.

The generously proportioned living room is equally bright and welcoming and features contemporary flooring, a feature fireplace with inset stove and a beautifully considered colour palette. Double doors connect this space with the fully remodelled kitchen and dining area.

The kitchen has been fitted with stylish new units, contrasting natural wood worktops and a substantial central island with breakfast seating. This wonderfully practical centrepiece provides generous space for food preparation, casual dining and family life.

The adjoining dining area is flooded with natural light from glazed patio doors overlooking the enclosed rear garden. A beautifully presented and fully upgraded guest WC, complete with a clever space-saving washbasin, along with an ideal sixed utility room completes the ground-floor accommodation of this wonderfully appointed home.

Upstairs, a bright landing illuminated by a gable window leads to three beautifully appointed bedrooms, each featuring premium flooring and built-in storage.

The most impressive master bedroom offers an abundance of floor space, fitted wardrobes and a fully refurbished ensuite. This luxurious space features contemporary floor-to-ceiling tiling, a newly fitted shower, heated towel rail and modern pedestal washbasin.

A further spacious double bedroom is positioned to the rear and enjoys views over the garden. The third bedroom, located to the front of the property, is currently configured as a comfortable and practical home office.

A fully upgraded family bathroom featuring contemporary fixtures and fittings completes the
upstairs accommodation.

Outside, the enclosed rear garden includes a generous patio and alfresco dining area, along with two fully equipped workshops with security fob access. 

The larger shed is fitted with its own heating system and offers tremendous potential for a hobbyist, craftsperson or home-based workspace. It may also offer scope for conversion to additional accommodation, subject to the necessary planning permission.

Key features include:
 Exceptional three-bedroom owner-occupied family home
 Quiet and child-friendly cul-de-sac setting
 Extensively upgraded and beautifully maintained
 Newly fitted energy-efficient composite front door
 Bright living room with feature fireplace and inset stove
 Fully remodelled kitchen with natural wood worktops
 Large central island and breakfast area
 Three bedrooms with built-in storage
 Refurbished ensuite with contemporary tiling
 Enclosed rear garden with patio and alfresco dining space
 Two fully equipped workshops, one with its own heating system
 Less than a minute’s drive from the M17/M18 motorway network
 Within walking distance of Tuam town centre
 Turnkey condition throughout

If you are searching for a turnkey, fully upgraded and superior family residence offering exceptional value in one of Tuam’s most desirable and convenient locations, then look no further than Number 62 Woodfield. This outstanding home is certain to meet all your requirements.

If this sounds like you, we would be delighted to hear from you and to assist in any way we can.

Brought to you by Fair Deal Property, your trusted experts for residential property sales.
